feed.title: AI Science Tracker: additions and source checks

entry.title: Machine learning guides yeast alcohol dehydrogenase specificity for trans-2-nonenal
entry.summary: Researchers measured a training library of yeast alcohol dehydrogenase I variants, used support-vector activity regression/classification and a thermostability model to rank combinations, then tested 22 prioritized variants. Four showed higher specific activity toward trans-2-nonenal than wild… (Discovery - RIKEN Center for Sustainable Resource Science; Graduate School of Science, Technology, and Innovation, Kobe University; announced 2026-11-01)

entry.title: Deep-learning design of zinc metalloproteases
entry.summary: RFdiffusion2 for Molecular Interfaces designs zinc-dependent proteases for peptide-bond hydrolysis. The primary paper reports cleavage at the targeted bond in 36% of 135 designs and selected designs that cleave disease-associated proteins in vitro. These biochemical results do not establish… (Discovery - Institute for Protein Design, University of Washington; announced 2026-10-14)

entry.title: vLLM shared cache keys allow cross-request state aliasing
entry.summary: Caller-controlled EXIF image identifiers and untyped prefix-cache extra keys can produce collisions between requests. The project advisory groups these two cache-identity sites together; the reported result is cross-request cached-state confusion, not demonstrated code execution. (Vulnerability - Patch the Planet (OpenAI and Trail of Bits); announced 2026-10-06)

entry.title: PCA mapping and machine learning prioritize antiplasmodial chemotypes
entry.summary: A PCA enrichment map and machine-learning virtual screening pipeline prioritized a commercial library for beta-haematin and parasite assays. The primary indexed paper reports several chemotypes evaluated for antiplasmodial activity, beta-haematin inhibition and haemozoin formation inhibition. This… (Discovery - University of Cape Town; announced 2026-09-29)

entry.title: Deep learning-guided synthesis yields fluid ferroelectric molecules
entry.summary: A graph variational autoencoder proposes molecules while learned classifiers and regressors, retrosynthesis and stock-inventory constraints guide selection. The journal version reports 11 first-generation materials characterized through mixture-based extrapolation and two additional materials… (Discovery - University of Leeds; announced 2026-09-11)

entry.title: ML-guided synthesis conditions produce EMT zeolite
entry.summary: Researchers trained models on 174 prior synthesis attempts and selected six EMT synthesis conditions for testing. Five yielded EMT by X-ray diffraction; two used starting-mixture Si/Al ratios outside the training range. EMT is an established framework, and the small, researcher-selected study does… (Discovery - University of Houston; announced 2026-08-04)

entry.title: REAP-guided engineering improves P450 BM3 activity
entry.summary: REAP combines a protein-language-model ranking predictor with active selection and automated build-and-test cycles. The study reports a P450 BM3 quintuple variant with 57-fold higher product yield than the engineered FL#62 starting scaffold in its high-throughput assay. This is a variant-specific… (Discovery - Tianjin University; Arizona State University; announced 2026-08-03)

entry.title: Active learning selects an oxygen electrode for protonic ceramic cells
entry.summary: A supervised DFT-trained model and Gaussian-process experimental loop guided selection of BaCo0.8Nb0.1Zr0.1O3−δ. The publisher abstract reports 2.68 W cm−2 peak fuel-cell power at 600 °C and a separate 500-hour electrolysis test. These are specified laboratory cell tests; the Research Square v1… (Discovery - Georgia Institute of Technology; announced 2026-07-21)

entry.title: UniKP prioritizes a sulfotransferase for sulfotyrosine production
entry.summary: UniKP was used to rank sulfotransferase homologues by predicted kinetics. The study reports experimental testing of five prioritized candidates and identifies EfST1A1, with about 6.5-fold higher in-vitro activity than the initial hit under the reported assay. Later directed evolution is not… (Discovery - Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2026-07-15)

entry.title: Diffusion-guided peptide design yields antimicrobial candidate Arcinin
entry.summary: ARCADIAMP combines iterative discrete diffusion generation, ESM2-based activity classifiers and sequence novelty filtering. Eight of ten experimentally screened candidates met the paper’s MIC threshold; Arcinin showed activity against tested pathogens and reduced bacterial burden in a mouse wound… (Discovery - University of California, Davis; announced 2026-07-07)

entry.title: AI-guided mining identifies and engineers an alkaline xylanase
entry.summary: A fine-tuned sequence model and generative workflow guided identification of xylanase 8E20 and mutant 8E20-178. The primary abstract reports an optimum-pH shift from 8 to 10 and a 1.9-fold improvement, but calls the metric catalytic activity while indexed conclusion text calls it catalytic… (Discovery - Institute of Animal Science, Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences; announced 2026-07-03)

entry.title: Deep learning guides higher-activity SpuFz1 nuclease variants
entry.summary: A DeepSequence-based predictor ranked SpuFz1 mutations without experimental activity labels; experimentally confirmed substitutions were combined into SpuFz1-v3. At the B2M locus in HEK293T cells, the article reports 35.52% indel formation versus 3.07% for wild type. Comparative sequence analysis… (Discovery - Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2026-06-18)

entry.title: Machine learning identifies a low-tin lead-free relaxor composition window
entry.summary: A multimodal literature-mining workflow and a physics-guided deep ensemble screened more than 150 million hypothetical compositions. The study reports that the x=0.01 and x=0.02 members of (Sr0.48Na0.26Bi0.26)(Ti1−xSnx)O3 met the authors’ predefined dielectric-stability targets while retaining… (Discovery - Seoul National University; Korea University; Yeungnam University; announced 2026-06-15)

entry.title: Fung-AI prioritizes peptides with measured antifungal activity
entry.summary: Fung-AI combines a generative adversarial network with learned antifungal and hemolysis classifiers to select peptides for testing. The study first tested five peptides from separate clusters; activity of peptide 40 prompted testing of eight more members from cluster 17. Five of the nine tested… (Discovery - Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory; Johns Hopkins University; announced 2026-06-15)

entry.title: Machine-learning screening guides thermochemical measurements of salt hydrates
entry.summary: Composition-based machine-learning models screened salt-hydration reactions, after which researchers synthesized and measured selected candidates by differential scanning calorimetry. The article reports volumetric energy densities of 1.74 ± 0.02, 1.73 ± 0.02 and 1.70 ± 0.02 GJ/m³ for three… (Discovery - University of Amsterdam; Radboud University; announced 2026-06-05)

entry.title: ML ranking identifies active sesquiterpene-synthase variants
entry.summary: A composite score combines Boltz2-predicted binding and DLKcat-predicted turnover to rank variants in a focused Agr5 library. Of 15 top-ranked variants tested, four produced more viridiflorol than wild-type Agr5; the paper reports 11.05-fold higher production for Y374F and a 952.79 mg/L titer in… (Discovery - Queen’s University; announced 2026-05-28)

entry.title: Machine learning guides a near-infrared Mo/Sb halide phosphor
entry.summary: A regression model trained on experimental and theoretical data guided Mo/Sb/Br co-doping for a lead-free near-infrared phosphor. The authors report synthesizing Cs₂Zr(Cl₀.₄₆Br₀.₅₄)₆:12%Mo⁴⁺/3.6%Sb³⁺, with emission near 920 nm, internal quantum efficiency of 92.4%, and external quantum efficiency… (Discovery - Guangxi University; South China University of Technology; announced 2026-05-15)

entry.title: BioGDR predicts cell-line sensitivity to an ALDH1B1 inhibitor
entry.summary: BioGDR combines molecular structure with learned, predicted gene-expression and kinase-effect features and transcriptomic cell representations. Prospective in-vitro tests confirmed differential sensitivity to Golgicide A-2, including T84 colorectal cells (reported IC50 1.09 μM). This is a… (Discovery - Shanghai Institute of Materia Medica, Chinese Academy of Sciences; announced 2026-05-13)

entry.title: PEPIC identifies a BHET-hydrolyzing enzyme candidate
entry.summary: PEPIC is a sequence-based convolutional model that predicts PET-hydrolyzing potential. The study reports prioritizing W2061_PET9 and experimentally showing that purified protein converts soluble BHET into MHET, confirmed by HPLC and mass spectrometry. The experiment used a soluble PET… (Discovery - SunMoon University; announced 2026-04-30)

entry.title: AggreProt-guided mutations improve LinB solubility and yield
entry.summary: AggreProt is a deep neural-network predictor of residue-level protein aggregation propensity. Researchers used its predicted aggregation-prone regions to guide mutations in haloalkane dehalogenase LinB and report reduced aggregation, improved soluble yield and up to a 100% increase in yield over… (Discovery - Masaryk University; announced 2026-04-28)

entry.title: CALPHAD-based transfer learning designs high-strength Al–Mg–Zn alloys
entry.summary: A CALPHAD-informed transfer-learning and multi-objective optimization workflow selected two laboratory alloys. The primary abstract reports tensile strengths of 472 ± 7 MPa and 569 ± 12 MPa, with elongations of 23.5 ± 0.5% and 14.9 ± 0.3%. These are measured alloy properties, not industrial… (Discovery - Central South University; Changsha University of Science and Technology; China Three Gorges University; announced 2026-04-10)

entry.title: Deep active learning identifies lithium-metal battery electrolytes with longer symmetric-cell lifetime
entry.summary: A two-stage framework combines deep-kernel active learning with transfer to expanded formulation spaces. The primary article reports electrolytes that increased average lifetime of lithium-metal symmetric cells threefold after three learning iterations and improved formulations in lithium-metal… (Discovery - Dalhousie University; University of Maryland; announced 2026-03-27)

entry.title: Machine learning identifies covalent organic frameworks for hydrogen peroxide photosynthesis
entry.summary: An ensemble machine-learning framework combined data augmentation, multilevel structural descriptors and physics-informed features to screen more than 10,000 covalent organic framework candidates. The researchers synthesized and tested eight selected COFs. The paper reports COF-343 at 12,978.7… (Discovery - Sichuan University; Technische Universität Berlin; announced 2026-03-25)

entry.title: Graph embedding identifies LC-61 with anti-Leishmania activity
entry.summary: A multiscale graph embedding workflow prioritized LC-61, which the study experimentally evaluated against L. infantum. The finding is a specific in-vitro compound result; it does not establish clinical efficacy, safety or a validated target. (Discovery - Federal University of Goiás; announced 2026-03-17)

entry.title: Machine learning selects W-doped nickel–iron oxyhydroxide for electrolysis
entry.summary: EquiformerV2-based interatomic predictions screened 3,976 configurations and guided W1–NiFeOOH selection. The journal reports 13.1 A cm−2 at 2.0 V and 80 °C in one anion-exchange-membrane electrolyzer test, and a separate >500-hour test at 1 A cm−2 and 60 °C. Conditions are distinct laboratory… (Discovery - Seoul National University; announced 2026-03-11)

entry.title: M3-CAD designs antimicrobial QLX-3DV peptides
entry.summary: M3-CAD combines sequence, predicted structural and physicochemical features in a multimodal peptide-design pipeline. The journal study reports in-vitro activity for selected QLX-3DV peptides, including untemplated candidates, against tested bacterial strains; selected leads also received… (Discovery - Qilu Hospital of Shandong University; Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen; announced 2026-03-09)

entry.title: Bayesian optimization identifies enzyme nanohybrids with high activity recovery
entry.summary: Parallelized hybrid-space Bayesian optimization prioritized metal/ligand carriers and conditions for enzyme immobilization. The primary abstract reports activity recovery of 100% for glucose oxidase, 90% for catalase and 79% for Candida antarctica lipase B across the demonstrated workflow. These… (Discovery - Tsinghua University; Synthera Biotechnology Co. Ltd.; announced 2026-03-07)

entry.title: Machine learning guides a low-precious-metal RWGS catalyst
entry.summary: An iterative machine-learning-guided campaign optimized precious-metal and additive compositions and support over 35 prediction–experiment cycles. The authors report a low-loading Pt–Ru–Pd catalyst that outperformed a commercial benchmark and their earlier high-PGM design in the reported reverse… (Discovery - Hokkaido University; announced 2026-02-25)

entry.title: ETopt-guided screening identifies thermophilic beta-agarases
entry.summary: ETopt combines sequence, structural and protein-language-model features in an ensemble XGBoost model to predict enzyme optimum temperatures. The authors report wet-lab screening that identified two novel thermophilic beta-agarases. The draft is limited to those source-identified enzyme findings… (Discovery - Ocean University of China; announced 2026-02-24)

entry.title: Pichia-CLM improves recombinant protein expression in Komagataella phaffii
entry.summary: A GRU encoder-decoder language model learns host-specific amino-acid-to-codon patterns and designs synonymous sequences. Across six proteins, the study reports the best titer for five against four commercial optimization tools; human serum albumin reached about threefold the native-sequence titer.… (Discovery - Massachusetts Institute of Technology; announced 2026-02-17)

entry.title: Perovskite-R1 suggests precursor additives tested in solar-cell devices
entry.summary: A domain-tuned QwQ-32B model generated precursor-additive suggestions. Researchers tested selected recommendations in perovskite solar-cell devices against controls and manually selected additives and report improved device performance and material stability in their tested conditions. Two tested… (Discovery - Renmin University of China; announced 2026-02-10)

entry.title: ML-guided FeCoCrMnCu hydroxide for oxygen evolution
entry.summary: An XGBoost model trained on measurements from 70 Fe–Co–Cr–Mn–Cu compositions selected a layered double hydroxide for oxygen evolution. The reported composition had a measured overpotential of 270 mV at 10 mA cm⁻², versus a model prediction of 261.3 mV; the paper also reports a 72-hour stability… (Discovery - National Chung Hsing University; announced 2026-02-03)

entry.title: Text mining and machine learning guide Eu-activated phosphor wavelength prediction
entry.summary: A literature text-mining pipeline extracted phosphor/emission examples for model development; four Eu2+-activated candidates were synthesized and characterized. In the author manuscript, CaGd2S4:Eu2+ emitted at 440 nm versus 451 nm predicted under 365 nm excitation. Formula Li2SiN2 in one abstract… (Discovery - Xiamen University; announced 2026-01-23)

entry.title: Iterative discovery of potent polymeric antibiotics via multi-stage and multi-task learning against antimicrobial resistance
entry.summary: PolyCLOVER integrated multi-stage learning, active learning and high-throughput experiments across a ~100,000-member poly(β-amino ester) space, identifying three lead nanoparticles with measured antibacterial activity and in-vivo mouse outcomes. Mouse groups were small; this does not establish… (Discovery - Zhejiang University; Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine; announced 2026-01-21)

entry.title: Tranylcypromine shows in-vitro activity against Leishmania major
entry.summary: The study experimentally tested the previously model-predicted drug tranylcypromine against L. major promastigotes and intracellular amastigotes. It reports IC50 values of 83.6 and 31.6 µg/mL, respectively, and macrophage CC50 of 282.3 µg/mL. These relatively high in-vitro concentrations do not… (Discovery - Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Université de Tunis El Manar; announced 2026-01-12)

entry.title: CleaveNet designs peptide substrates with MMP13 cleavage profiles
entry.summary: CleaveNet combines a generative model conditioned on protease cleavage profiles with a predictor that ranks candidate sequences. In an in-vitro screen of 95 peptide substrates against 12 matrix metalloproteinases, the authors report that designed substrates were cleaved by MMP13 and identify… (Discovery - Microsoft Research; announced 2026-01-06)

entry.title: Diffusion-guided design tests bimetallic ammonia-decomposition catalysts
entry.summary: A diffusion model guided by a learned nitrogen-adsorption predictor generated bimetallic candidates near the target adsorption energy. entry.title: ML-guided CRISPRi combinations improve isoprenol production
entry.summary: An ensemble of machine-learning regressors recommended combinations of up to four CRISPRi guide RNAs during six design–build–test–learn cycles in engineered Pseudomonas putida. entry.title: TARSA prioritizes peptides active against breast cancer cells
entry.summary: TARSA combines reinforcement learning and posterior sampling to search a 36-million-sequence library of experimentally resolved helical peptides. entry.title: Data-centric machine learning prioritizes compounds for Trypanosoma cruzi assays
